title: 第14章  现在不回部队了？以后包回去的！
slug: 四次入伍我被军区拉进黑名单
content_zh:
不知是谁说了句。
王冲闻声猛地转头，目光顺着学生示意的方向看去。
远处跑道上，六道身影正急匆匆朝着这边狂奔而来，动作慌乱，跑的乱七八糟。
唯独其中一名把帽檐压下来的学生，跑的很是标准，一看就是经常跑步的人。
他原本就黑沉着的脸色，立刻又阴沉了几分，眼底怒火直冒。
军训第一天，整个宿舍全员集体迟到，简直是把纪律两个字按在地上摩擦！
王冲心底怒火翻涌，咬牙打定主意，今天这几个人，必须严惩，绝不姑息！
不然以后整个班级纪律彻底松散，根本没法带！
几秒后，林毅一行人快步冲到操场队列前。
五个舍友跑得满头大汗、气息紊乱，紧张得手脚都不知道往哪放。
其中一名舍友硬着头皮，抬手敬礼，声音发颤。
“报告教官！我们……我们到了！”
话音刚落，王冲的怒骂直接劈头盖脸砸了下来：“到了？我让你们几点集合！看看现在几点了！”
“军训第一天就集体迟到，无视纪律、无视集体，态度极其散漫！”
“我刚刚已经给他们立下了规矩，我再跟你们说一遍，但凡后续有人迟到、拖沓、违反军训纪律，一律加倍训练！别人练一遍，你就练两遍！别人休息，你继续加练！”
“所以，你们今天所有人的基础训练量翻倍！别人练一遍，你们六个练两遍！全程加练，不许休息！”
听到这话，五名舍友脸色惨白，心里咯噔一下，双腿都微微发软。
双倍训练量，对于他们这种从没吃过苦的普通学生来说，简直是地狱难度。
但几人没有半点怨言，更没有一人怪罪林毅。
大家心里门儿清，今天这事纯属他们自己拖累人。

林毅早就准时收拾完毕，是他们内务太差、手脚笨拙，浪费了大量时间。
人家完全可以不管他们、自己先跑过来集合，稳稳准时到位。
是他们厚着脸皮让林毅帮忙指导，硬生生连累这位老兵一起迟到、一起受罚。
此刻几人心里又愧疚又尴尬，满脑子都是对不起林毅。
反观队列里其他没迟到的学生，一个个偷偷抬眼瞥着被罚的五人，眼底藏着难以掩饰的幸灾乐祸。
刚才全队陪着挨训的憋屈，这一刻烟消云散，心里莫名舒坦了不少。
让你们迟到！挨罚也是活该！
王冲冷着脸，目光锐利地盯着五人，沉声质问：“说！为什么迟到！”
五个舍友紧张得不敢开口。
这时，队伍最外侧，林毅微微压低帽檐，不慌不忙的开口：“报告教官！他们不熟悉内务标准，我教他们整理内务了，耽误了集合时间。”
一听这话，王冲当场火气顶满，想都没想直接开怼：“整理内务？开学第一天、军训第一天，我还没安排内务训练，你们整理个屁的……”
话吼到一半，王冲话音骤然卡住。
不对劲。
非常不对劲。
今天军训内容只涉及队列整队，压根没安排内务学习，这群新生怎么可能主动跑去整理内务？
更离谱的是……这个声音。
太熟悉了！
熟悉到刻在耳朵里、印在骨子里，哪怕压低了声线、刻意收敛语气，他也能立刻分辨出来。
这绝对是在装甲一连待过的老手，而且是他极其熟悉的那个人！
王冲心头猛地一跳，满腔怒火僵在胸口，下意识迈步上前。

他微微低头，伸手轻轻抬开林毅压低的帽檐。
下一秒，一张熟悉到不能再熟悉的脸庞映入眼帘。
硬朗的眉眼、散漫又熟悉的眼神，哪怕褪去军装、换上校服，那股子老兵独有的气质半点没变。
王冲瞳孔骤缩，整个人当场石化，脱口而出，声音满是震惊和难以置信：“卧槽？班长！”
顿时，全场一片死寂。
操场上所有学生集体一脸懵逼，大脑当场宕机。
啥玩意？
威严满满的军训教官，居然对着一个迟到的复读生喊班长？
站在最前面的五名舍友更是瞳孔地震，嘴巴张得能塞下一个鸡蛋，满脸难以置信。
教官居然叫林毅班长？！
他们本来还以为林毅只是个普通退伍老兵，顶多比他们这些普通学生能吃苦、懂纪律而已，万万没想到含金量这么高！
能让现役教官尊称一句班长，这说明林毅在部队里的地位，压根不一般！
他们这位老大哥，牛逼啊！
全场所有人的目光，全部死死聚焦在两人身上，满是好奇与震惊。
万众瞩目之下，林毅看着眼前满脸错愕的王冲，打趣道：“到底还是让豹哥你认出来了。”
听到这个久违的称呼，王冲浑身猛地一哆嗦，立刻从刚才的暴怒教官模式，切换成乖巧新兵模式。
他欲哭无泪，连连摆手：“别别别！班长您可别这么叫我，折煞我了！”
外人根本不知道其中的渊源。
当年王冲刚入伍，新兵下连的时候，分配到的班长正是刘畅。
那时候林毅已经在部队稳扎稳打待了五年，带兵经验极其丰富，手法老练、手段刁钻。

老班长刘畅平时懒得操心新兵琐事，经常偷懒摸鱼，直接把带新兵的重任全权甩给林毅。
而王冲本名和水浒好汉林冲只差一个字，林毅闲着没事，常年调侃他是“豹哥”，这外号一叫就是一年。
早年的王冲性格火爆、脾气又冲，是班里是出了名的小刺头，谁都不服、谁也不怕，偏偏在林毅手里没少吃苦头。
别人管不住的刺头，林毅专治。
林毅经常性的拍拍王冲的肩膀，笑呵呵的跟他说“干的好啊，必须得提干了！”
第一次他还以为林毅夸他呢，可等晚上回到了宿舍，他才知道原来提干的意思是……提起来，狠狠地干！
然后就是各种针对性提干加练、魔鬼纠偏、细节打磨，一套流程下来，桀骜不驯的王冲没几天就被驯得服服帖帖、老老实实。
也正因如此，哪怕林毅都已经退伍了，王冲也不敢在林毅面前造次啊。
王冲愣了半天，才消化完眼前的事实，一脸不可思议地看着林毅：“班长，你……你退伍来复读了？”
“嗯，复读考学。”林毅随意点头。
王冲好奇问道：“那这么说，你确定不回部队了？”
“我都复读了，肯定是回不去了。”林毅坦然道。
现在是肯定回不去了，他得在学校里好好学习。
至于以后嘛……包回去的！
念及此，林毅拍了拍他肩膀，语重心长道：“豹哥，你是我最看好的兵，我第一次看你就觉得，你天生就是部队的人，听我一句，一定要在部队留下。”
毕竟，等我以后军校毕业回咱们连队的时候，还要给你提干呢！狠狠地提干！
林毅如实想到，但没说。
content_en:
I don’t know who said it.
Wang Chong turned his head suddenly when he heard the sound and looked in the direction indicated by the student.
On the runway in the distance, six figures were running towards this side in a hurry, their movements were panic and they were running in a mess.
Only one of the students, who had his hat brim down, ran very standardly, and he looked like a regular runner.
His originally dark complexion immediately became gloomier again, and his eyes were filled with anger.
On the first day of military training, everyone in the dormitory was late. It was like rubbing the word "discipline" on the ground!
Anger surged in Wang Chong's heart, and he gritted his teeth and made up his mind. Today, these people must be severely punished and will never be tolerated!
Otherwise, the discipline of the entire class will be completely loose in the future, and there will be no way to lead it!
A few seconds later, Lin Yi and his group rushed to the queue on the playground.
The five roommates were sweating profusely from running, their breathing was disordered, and they were so nervous that they didn’t know where to put their hands and feet.
One of the roommates braced himself and raised his hand in salute, his voice trembling.
"Report to the instructor! We...we are here!"
As soon as he finished speaking, Wang Chong's angry curse hit him directly in the face: "Are we here? What time did I tell you to gather! Look what time it is now!"
"We were all late on the first day of military training, ignored discipline and the collective, and had an extremely lax attitude!"
"I have just set rules for them, and I will tell you again, if anyone is late, procrastinates, or violates military training disciplines, they will train twice as hard! If others train once, you train twice! If others take a break, you continue to train extra!"
"So, all of you will do double the amount of basic training today! Others will do it once, and the six of you will do it twice! Do additional training throughout the whole process, and no rest is allowed!"
Hearing this, the five roommates' faces turned pale, their hearts thumped, and their legs became slightly weak.
Double the amount of training is simply hellish difficulty for ordinary students like them who have never endured hardship.
But few people had any complaints, and no one blamed Lin Yi.
Everyone knows clearly that what happened today is purely their own fault.
Ji Yi had already finished cleaning up on time. It was because of their poor housekeeping and clumsy hands that they wasted a lot of time.
You can completely ignore them and run over to gather yourself first, and get there on time.
It was they who shamelessly asked Lin Yi to help guide them, forcing the veteran to be late and punished.
At this moment, several people felt guilty and embarrassed, and their minds were full of feeling sorry for Ji Yi.
On the other hand, the other students in the queue who were not late secretly glanced at the five people who had been punished, with unconcealable gloating hidden in their eyes.
The frustration of being trained by the whole team just now disappeared, and I felt inexplicably relieved.
Make you late! You deserve the punishment!
Wang Chong had a cold face, stared at the five people with sharp eyes, and asked in a deep voice: "Tell me! Why are you late!"
The five roommates were too nervous to speak.
At this time, at the outermost side of the team, Lin Yi lowered the brim of his hat slightly and spoke calmly: "Report to the instructor! They are not familiar with housekeeping standards. I taught them to organize housekeeping, which delayed the assembly time."
Upon hearing this, Wang Chong became furious on the spot and started to argue without even thinking: "Tidying up the housekeeping? It's the first day of school and the first day of military training. I haven't arranged housekeeping training yet, so you guys are doing nothing..."
In the middle of shouting, Wang Chong's voice suddenly got stuck.
Something is wrong.
Something is very wrong.
Today's military training only involves forming a team, and there is no arrangement for housekeeping studies. How could these freshmen take the initiative to organize housekeeping?
What's even more outrageous is... this voice.
So familiar!
It was so familiar that it was engraved in his ears and imprinted in his bones. Even if he lowered his voice and deliberately restrained his tone, he could tell it immediately.
This is definitely a veteran who has been in the 1st Armored Company, and he is someone he is extremely familiar with!
Wang Chong's heart skipped a beat, his chest filled with anger froze, and he subconsciously stepped forward.
He lowered his head slightly and reached out to gently lift the brim of Ji Yi's lowered hat.The next second, an extremely familiar face came into view.
With his strong brows and casual yet familiar eyes, even if he took off his military uniform and changed into a school uniform, the unique temperament of a veteran has not changed at all.
Wang Chong's pupils shrank suddenly, and he turned to stone on the spot. He blurted out, his voice full of shock and disbelief: "What the hell? Squad leader!"
Suddenly, the whole place fell silent.
All the students on the playground were collectively confused, and their brains shut down on the spot.
What the hell?
The majestic military training instructor actually called monitor to a late repeater?
The five roommates standing at the front had their pupils trembling, their mouths wide enough to fit an egg in, their faces full of disbelief.
The instructor actually called Lin Yi monitor? !
They originally thought that Lin Yi was just an ordinary veteran who could endure hardships and understand discipline better than ordinary students like them. They never expected that the gold content was so high!
For active duty instructors to be respectfully addressed as squad leader, this shows that Lin Yi's status in the army is not ordinary at all!
This big brother of theirs is awesome!
The eyes of everyone in the room were all focused on the two of them, full of curiosity and shock.
Under the spotlight, Lin Yi looked at the astonished Wang Chong in front of him and joked: "Brother Bao, you still recognized him after all."
Hearing this long-lost title, Wang Chong shivered violently and immediately switched from the angry instructor mode to the well-behaved recruit mode.
He was about to cry but had no tears, so he waved his hands repeatedly: "No, no, no, no! Monitor, please don't call me that, it's embarrassing!"
Outsiders have no idea of its origins.
When Wang Chong first joined the army and the new recruits were assigned to the company, the squad leader assigned to him was Liu Chang.
At that time, Lin Yi had been working steadily in the army for five years. He had extensive experience in leading troops, and his tactics were sophisticated and tricky.
The old squad leader Liu Chang was usually too lazy to worry about the trivial matters of the new recruits. He often took advantage of the situation and simply left the responsibility of bringing up the new recruits to Lin Yi.
There is only one word difference between Wang Chong's real name and Water Margin hero Lin Chong. When Lin Yi has nothing to do, he teases him as "Brother Leopard" all year round. This nickname lasts for a year.
In his early years, Wang Chong had a fiery personality and a bad temper. He was known as a thorn in the class. He refused to accept and was not afraid of anyone, but he suffered a lot at the hands of Lin Yi.
Lin Yi specializes in dealing with the thorns that others cannot control.
Ji Yi often patted Wang Chong on the shoulder and said to him with a smile, "Well done, I must mention it!"
The first time he thought Lin Yi was praising him, but when he returned to the dormitory at night, he realized that the original meaning of lifting up meant... lift it up and fuck it hard!
Then came all kinds of targeted improvement and training, devilish corrections, and polishing of details. After a set of procedures, the unruly Wang Chong was tamed into a docile and honest person within a few days.
Because of this, even if Ji Yi has already retired from the army, Wang Chong does not dare to make a mistake in front of Ji Yi.
Wang Chong was stunned for a long time before he finished digesting the facts in front of him. He looked at Ji Yi with a look of disbelief on his face: "Squad leader, you...are you retiring from the army to resume your studies?"
"Well, let's retake the exam." Ji Yi nodded casually.
Wang Chong asked curiously: "So, are you sure you won't return to the army?"
"I have re-read it, and I will definitely not be able to go back." Lin Yi said calmly.
There is definitely no way he can go back now. He has to study hard in school.
As for the future...it will be taken back!
Thinking of this, Ji Yi patted him on the shoulder and said sincerely: "Brother Bao, you are my most promising soldier. The first time I saw you, I felt that you were born to be in the army. Listen to me, you must stay in the army."
After all, when I graduate from the military academy and return to our company, I will have to give you a promotion! Lift hard!
Ji Yi thought of it truthfully, but didn't say it.
